Custom device and firmware development

If the device you need does not exist, we take the circuit, enclosure, firmware and app from prototype to a small batch. Qilich builds the MVP in 8–14 weeks, from UZS 120 mln; the full version in 20–40 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

Timeline and price

Timeline
MVP 8–14 weeksFull 20–40 weeks

Who it is for
Startups, Manufacturing, Agriculture, Energy and utilities

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Requirements
  • Electronics on ESP32 or STM32
  • Firmware
  • 3D-printed enclosure
  • Companion app or dashboard
  • 3–5 working prototypes
What the full version adds
  • PCB design for production
  • Certification support
  • Over-the-air updates
  • Coordination with a manufacturer
  • A batch of 100–1,000 units
  • Device management platform
Please note

Components and manufacturing are paid separately from development.

What we need from you

  • Site access and space for the devices
  • Internet or SIM cards
  • A budget for the hardware, which is not in the price

Questions

What does “Custom device and firmware development” cost?
At Qilich the MVP costs $10,000–25,000 (UZS 120–305 mln) and the full version $35,000–100,000 (UZS 420–1,205 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Custom device and firmware development” take?
Qilich builds the MVP in 8–14 weeks and the full version in 20–40 weeks.
What do we need to provide for “Custom device and firmware development”?
Site access and space for the devices; internet or SIM cards; a budget for the hardware, which is not in the price.

Prefer to talk? Call +998 97 270 70 07 or send Qilich an enquiry.
